title: Favorite tenor, trumpet and bass players
summary: He names Ben Webster, Lester Young, Roy Eldridge, Hot Lips Page and Blanton.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Trumpeters I admired: rating the horn players

blocks.x: Listen, Gus, just before we finish, I didn't ask you anything about some of the real fine instrumentalists. I'd like to know who really knocked you out, like -- you told about the tenor saxophone players.
All of those were my top tenormen, every one of those.
Yeah. What about the trumpet players?
Clark Terry, but before Clark Terry, before I knew him, Hot Lips Page.
Oh, I know, he was wonderful, beautiful, fine. And could sing.
Oh, yes, he could sing the blues and play his horn.
And Sweets Edison. He's still one of my top trumpet players. Just like, as I said, Clark Terry.
This Mumbles." Well, he used to do that, just sitting in the band with Basie before he ever --
Just kidding along, and when he made the record, I was surprised. I said, 'You did the same thing you did in the bus,' one of those things.
And he told me, when he made that with Oscar Peterson. Oscar Pettiford was a very good bass player, too. Blanton.
Yes, he was, yeah. Yeah, Blanton was wonderful, too.
